title: Buffer Power and Gate Batches
description: Place an Energy Cube between generators and heavy consumers to smooth batch spikes. Configure each face as Disabled, Input or Output inside the screen or by shift-right-clicking the face with an empty hand; upgrade to Reinforced or Resonant tiers as throughput grows.
Attach a vanilla Redstone Comparator to an Energy Cube, Matter Drive, Cell Transfer Station, Machine Port or processor to read stored energy, cell fill or active batch progress as a 0 to 15 signal.
Open any processor's Settings tab to switch Redstone control between Ignored, High, Low and Pulse so standby lines pause cleanly when reserve thresholds are met.
